harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: (والذاريات ذروا) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The wāw is for the oath, and what is sworn by (muqsam bihi) is genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied "I swear". «ذَرْوًا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) governed by its derivative, namely the active participle; the object is omitted by restriction (iqtiṣār), since there is no counterpart to what it scatters here.

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: His words «فالحاملات»: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «الذاريات»; «وِقْرا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «الحاملات».

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: «يسرا» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); its adjective has taken its place, i.e. "a running with ease".

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: (إنما توعدون لصادق) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is the response to the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: (وإن الدين لواقع) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the response to the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: «والسماء»: sworn by (muqsam bihi), attached to (mutaʿalliq) "I swear"; «ذات» is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: (إنكم لفي قول مختلف) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The clause «يؤفك» is an adjective (ṣifa) of {قَوْلٍ}; «مَنْ» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: (قتل الخراصون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective); «ساهون» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The clause «يسألون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from {الْخَرَّاصُونَ}. «أيان» is an interrogative noun, an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) a khabar (predicate) placed first; «يوم» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «أيان يوم الدين» is the object of the asking, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative.

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: «يوم» is the object of an implied "I mean"; the preposition «على النار» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يُفْتنون», which carries the implied meaning of "they are exposed".

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The clause «ذوقوا» is the maqūl al-qawl (content of the saying) of an implied saying, and the clause «هذا الذي» is resumptive within the scope of the saying. The preposition «به» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تستعجلون».

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: (إن المتقين في جنات وعيون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: «آخذين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun of being (istiqrār) in the khabar (predicate) of «إنّ»; «ما» is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the active participle. The clause «إنهم كانوا» is resumptive; «قبل» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar of «كان».

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The clause «كانوا» is a badal (substitute) from the earlier {كَانُوا}; the clause «يهجعون» is the khabar (predicate) of «كان»; «ما» is redundant (zāʾida), and «قليلا» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the implied form being "they used to sleep, of the night, a little sleep".

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: (وبالأسحار هم يستغفرون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يستغفرون», and the clause «هم يستغفرون» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause {يَهْجَعُونَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The preposition «للسائل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «حق», and the clause «وفي أموالهم حق» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause {هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: (وفي الأرض آيات للموقنين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive; the preposition «للموقنين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «آيات».

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The preposition «وفي أنفسكم» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to {وَفِي الأَرْضِ} and is attached to (mutaʿalliq) what that is attached to; the clause «أفلا تبصرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The clause «وفي السماء رزقكم» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «في الأرض آيات»; «ما» is a relative noun conjoined to «رزقكم».

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause «إنه لحق» is the response to the oath. «مثل» is a naʿt (adjective) of «حق», made indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is annexed to an indeclinable word; «ما» is redundant (zāʾida), and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: «المكرمين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «ضيف», and «ضيف» is singular with a plural meaning.

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: «إذ» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) {حَدِيثُ}, i.e. "has their story reached you, occurring at the time they entered upon him?" «سلاما» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "we greet with a greeting". «سلام» is mubtadaʾ (subject) with an implied khabar (predicate), i.e. "peace be upon you". «قوم» is the khabar of an implied mubtadaʾ, i.e. "you".

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The clause «فراغ» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause {قَالَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The preposition «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «خيفة». The clause «فأوجس» is resumptive, as is the clause «قالوا», and the clause «وبشَّروه» is a ḥāl.

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The clause «فأقبلت» is resumptive; the preposition «في صرة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «امرأته»; the clause «فصكَّت» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «أقبلت». «عجوز» is the khabar (predicate) of an implied «أنا», and «وعقيم» is a second khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: (كذلك قال ربك) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "He said a saying like that saying". The clause «قال» is the maqūl al-qawl (content of the saying), and the clause «إنه هو الحكيم» is resumptive; «هو» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the hāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: (فما خطبكم أيها المرسلون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The fāʾ connects (rābiṭa) to the apodosis (jawāb) of an implied condition, i.e. "if you have been sent for a matter, then what is your business?" «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «خطبكم» is its khabar (predicate). The clause «أيها المرسلون» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and «المرسلون» is ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition).

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) «لنرسل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) {أُرْسِلْنَا}; the preposition «من طين» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «حجارة».

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: «مسومة» is a second naʿt (adjective) of {حِجَارَةً}; «عند» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مسومة», as is «للمسرفين».

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: The clause «فأخرجنا» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause {أُرْسِلْنَا} in verse (32); the preposition «من المؤمنين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun that is the noun (ism) of «كان».

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The clause «فما وجدنا» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «أخرجنا»; «غير» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition «من المسلمين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «غير».

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: The clause «وتركنا» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «ما وجدنا»; the preposition «للذين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «آية».

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: The preposition «وفي موسى» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the preposition {فِيهَا} in the previous verse, with the preposition repeated because what it is conjoined to is a genitive pronoun; so it is attached to (mutaʿalliq) what that is attached to. «إذ» is an adverbial noun, a badal (substitute) of inclusion (ishtimāl) from «موسى». The preposition «بسلطان» is attached to «أرسلناه».

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: The clause «فَتَوَلَّى» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause {أَرْسَلْنَاهُ}; the preposition «بركنه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «تولى»; «ساحر» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "he". «أو» is for doubt: he put himself — although he knew him to be a prophet — in the position of one doubting his matter, to deceive his people.

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: The clause «فأخذناه» is resumptive; «جنوده» is a noun maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the hāʾ; and the clause «وهو مليم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «أخذناه».

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The preposition «وفي عاد» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «في موسى» in verse (38); «إذ» is an adverbial noun, a badal (substitute) of inclusion (ishtimāl) from «عاد».

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: The clause «ما تذر» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from {الرِّيحَ}; «شيء» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); the clause «أتت» is a naʿt (adjective) of «شيء»; the clause «جَعَلَتْه» is a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of «تذر»; and the preposition «كالرميم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: «وفي ثمود» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «في عاد» in verse (41); «إذ» is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (ishtimāl) from «ثمود». The nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «قيل» is the pronoun of the maṣdar (verbal noun). «حتى» is a particle of limit and of the genitive, and «حين» is a genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: The clause «فعتوا» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause {قِيلَ}, and the clause «وهم ينظرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The clause «فما استطاعوا» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «أخذتهم»; «قيام» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and «من» is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: His words «وقوم»: the object of an implied «أهلكنا», and the clause of the implied verb is resumptive; the preposition «من قبل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied verb; and the clause «إنهم كانوا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «قوم نوح».

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: His words «والسماء»: accusative (manṣūb) by an omitted verb explained by what follows it, and the implied clause is resumptive; the clause «بنيناها» is explicative. The preposition «بأيد» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «بنيناها», and the clause «وإنَّا لموسعون» is a ḥāl from the fāʿil of «بنيناها».

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: His words «والأرض»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb explained by what follows it, and the implied clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the implied clause «بنيناها»; the clause «فرشناها» is explicative. The clause «فنعم الماهدون» is conjoined to the clause «فرشناها», and the one specified [for praise] by «نعم» is omitted, i.e. "We".

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: (ومن كل شيء خلقنا زوجين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The wāw is conjunctive, and the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خلقنا»; the clause «خَلَقْنا» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the implied clause «فرشنا», and the clause «لعلكم تذكرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: The clause «ففروا» is resumptive, as is the clause «إني ... نذير»; the two prepositions are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نذير»; «مبين» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The clause «ولا تجعلوا» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «فِرُّوا»; «مع» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object; «آخر» is a naʿt (adjective) of «إلها»; and the clause «إني ... نذير» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: (كذلك ما أتى الذين من قبلهم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The kāf is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "the matter is thus", and the clause is resumptive, as is the clause «ما أتى»; «رسول» is the fāʿil (agent) and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). The clause «قالوا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الذين»; «ساحر» is the khabar of an implied «هو».

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: The clause «أتواصوا» is resumptive, as is the clause «هم قوم».

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: The clause «تَوَلَّ» is resumptive; the clause «فما أنت بملوم» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the resumptive clause, and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar (predicate) of «ما».

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: The clause «وذَكِّر» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «تَوَلَّ», and the clause «فإن الذكرى تنفع» is conjoined to the clause «ذكِّر».

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: The clause «وما خلقت» is resumptive; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr). His words «ليعبدون»: the lām is causal; the verb is an imperfect, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «أن», the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the nūn is that of protection (wiqāya), and the implied yāʾ is the object of the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: The clause «ما أريد» is resumptive, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يطعمون» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: «هو» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); «ذو» is a second khabar (predicate); «المتين» is a third khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: The clause «فإن للذين» is resumptive; «مثل» is a naʿt (adjective), and «مثل» does not become definite through annexation. The clause «فلا يستعجلون» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the resumptive clause, and «يستعجلون» is like {لِيَعْبُدُونِ}.

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: The clause «فويل» is resumptive; «ويل» is mubtadaʾ (subject), and beginning with an indefinite noun is permitted because it expresses an imprecation. The preposition «من يومهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ويل»; «الذي» is a naʿt of «يومهم».
